outcome: Delay between GBS onset and hospital admission
cohort: Pregnant women with GBS diagnosed in French University Hospitals in the 2002-2022 period compared to a reference group of same-age non-pregnant women with GBS identified in the same institutions & timeframe
finding: Guillain-Barre syndrome during pregnancy is a severe maternal condition associated with significant fetal mortality and increased maternal morbidity compared to non-pregnant women with GBS.
mod_finding: Unscheduled caesarean section was needed in 31% of pregnant women with GBS.
